profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Advisys Inc.
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing, building, and modernizing full-stack web applications in the financial services industry. Skilled in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Web API, RESTful APIs, SQL Server, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and ExtJS, with hands-on experience in Azure DevOps CI/CD, AWS, and secure integrations using SAML SSO, OAuth 2.0, and JWT. Proven track record of improving system performance, automating manual processes, and delivering features from design through production release. Strong communicator who explains technical work in plain language to non-technical teams. Fluent in English, Spanish, and Vietnamese.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer on the financial planning platform used by advisors at enterprise partners in insurance and banking, owning work across the full stack and the secure integrations that connect partners to it.
  • Leading a redesign of the main advisor application, released side by side with the existing UI across 50+ branded client themes so it can roll out gradually without disrupting users.
  • Moved ~4,400 users of a major insurer to Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on with automatic account provisioning; own SAML 2.0 SSO for 5 enterprise partners.
  • Built a Salesforce integration (OAuth 2.0, REST) that sends client data from our platform to a partner's CRM.
  • Secured a partner-facing API with mutual TLS and JWT authentication.
  • Own the build and release pipeline from development to production in Azure DevOps.
  • Built React components for a prototype of the next-generation UI.
  • Mentored teammates and contractors and reviewed their code.
  • Explain technical work to sales and client teams in plain language.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Built and maintained the financial-planning calculators advisors use to create client plans, working across the full stack: UI, C# calculation engine, SQL Server, and PDF reports.
• Delivered 7 new calculators end to end, including Charitable Remainder Trust, Mortgage Refinance, and 529-to-Roth IRA Rollover.
• Diagnosed and fixed production bugs and performance bottlenecks across the platform.
• Fixed calculation-accuracy bugs in the Social Security calculator and updated it to 2024 SSA rules.
• Modernized legacy code, including rewriting a VB calculator in C# with unit tests.
• Built a client portal with on-demand PDF reports.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Built full-stack features, responsive UI components, and REST APIs with Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, and C# / .NET on  SQL Server.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Selected from the student cohort to assist instructors. Led live coding lectures and helped students debug full-stack applications in Python / Django, Angular, and .NET / C#.

positions.description:

-Organized company files and creating support system to decrease workload and increase productivity of
account managers.

business opportunities.
